contexts.text: Thy seal () = a token of consent... because in ancient times decrees were confirmed by a seal, and therefore a seal properly = confirmation itself, and testification that it is so.
The external of the Church is signified by a seal, etc.
Those who have a seal upon their foreheads () = those who have been regenerated.

The engravings of a signet () = the heavenly form of all Truths such as is in the Intellectual of a regenerate man; for therein the truths of faith are disposed into a heavenly form. AC 9877, Explained.
The engraving of a signet () = the heavenly sphere. Explained.
The Holy Supper is the seal of this conjunction. TCR 728. Explained.
The opening of the seals of the Book by the Lamb = the manifestation of these states of the Church by the Lord.
Sealed up with seven seals () = the Word completely hidden from Angel and man. AE 300.
To open the Book, and loose its seals () = to know the states of life of all in the Heavens and on earth, and also to judge everyone according to his state. AR 295. AR 324. AR 330. AR 388. AE 303.
Having the seal of the living God (). = who alone Knows all and each, and can distinguish and separate them from one another. ( = the Divine will. AE 423.)
To open a seal = to explore the states of life; or, what is the same, the states of the Church and thence of the life.
Those who have not the seal of God in their foreheads () = those not in charity and the derivative faith... To have the seal = to know them and distinguish them from others. AE 546.
(Those represented by the turtles) carry a certain small mark on their garments...
Opened the first of the seals = the first manifestation; for to open a seal = to reveal the hidden things which are written inside. AE 361. AE 369. AE 378. AE 390. AE 399. AE 486.
The engraving of a signet = permanence to eternity.
